dedupe_keys.name: uk mineral processing refining and recycling facilities bgs critical minerals intelligence centre

description: This BGS dataset lists 115 prominent mineral processing, refining and recycling facilities in the United Kingdom, with their locations, the type of operation, commodities handled, facility status, role in the critical minerals value chain and indicative outputs where available. It underpins the Critical Minerals Intelligence Centre's interactive map of the UK and is meant for policy development and market intelligence on the country's midstream minerals capability. The January 2026 version was published on 26 March 2026 through the National Geoscience Data Centre as an Excel workbook (about 34 KB) with a README file, open under the Open Government Licence ("Contains data supplied by UKRI"). Caveats: it is a high-level snapshot of key facilities, not a complete register, and outputs are indicative and not given for every site. For simulation it maps the UK's critical mineral processing and recycling nodes, useful to model supply chain chokepoints, facility outages and the effect of hazards on refining capacity. Related catalogue records include the UK Minerals Yearbook, BGS BritPits and the Canadian critical minerals mines and processing facilities dataset.
